CLTCODE='17128' will be updated on the next run. 
CLTCODE='888888' will be deleted from the source on the next run .
CLTCODE='555555' will have no change in details, only filename date will be changed.
CLTCODE='999999' will be inserted as new record in the source on the next run(not yet inserted on the target table).

SELECT CLTCODE CLTCODE2, * FROM
EDS.SEC_ACCTLINK WHERE CLTCODE='17128'
UNION ALL
SELECT CLTCODE CLTCODE2, * FROM
EDS.SEC_ACCTLINK WHERE CLTCODE='888888'
UNION ALL
SELECT CLTCODE CLTCODE2, * FROM
EDS.SEC_ACCTLINK WHERE CLTCODE='555555'
UNION ALL
SELECT CLTCODE CLTCODE2, * FROM
EDS.SEC_ACCTLINK WHERE CLTCODE='999999'
